title: Northflank security breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys
description: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform after a security breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: New Android SMS of Death exploit can remotely crash unpatched phones
description: A security researcher has released a proof-of-concept exploit for a recently patched Android vulnerability, dubbed "SMS of Death" and tracked as CVE-2026-58882, that lets attackers remotely disrupt cellular service or crash phones by sending a specially crafted text message. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: Reddit to lock content behind logins to fight scrapers
description: Reddit announced in a post by co-founder Steve Huffman that the site will gradually become a "logged-in service," offering limited access to visitors without accounts. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: From Beginner to Bug Hunter: Learning Cybersecurity in the AI Era.
description: AI-generated vulnerability reports are overwhelming some bug bounty programs, making it harder for aspiring security researchers to know where to start. TryHackMe explains how beginners can build practical cybersecurity skills, use AI responsibly, and produce reproducible findings that stand up to scrutiny. [...]

title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"
description: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles. [...]
author: Ax Sharma
